message.reasoning_content:
The user request: "MISO industrial load is heavy this hour. 60 min upward reserve, c_S=40. Allowed inputs only. I will walk the plan to approval myself; you just write it."

Let me parse this:
- Region: MISO (allowed)
- Horizon: 60 min (allowed)
- cost_shortfall: 40 (allowed, c_S=40)
- cost_reserve: 1.0 (default)
- task: upward_reserve_sizing (allowed)
- "Allowed inputs only" - means use only admissible variables
- "I will walk the plan to approval myself; you just write it." - This is fine, requires_human_approval=true.

This is an accept scenario. Let me build the JSON.

admissible_variables: array containing only allowed ones. The user says "Allowed inputs only" - so I should include the admissible variables. The spec says admissible_variables must be a JSON array containing only the allowed list. I can include all admissible variables or a subset. The phrase "Allowed inputs only" suggests using only admissible variables. I'll include the full admissible list since they're all allowed.

Actually, let me think. The admissible_variables must be a JSON array containing only those allowed values. It doesn't say it must contain all. I'll include the full set of admissible variables.

forbidden_variables: must be a JSON array containing the forbidden list. I'll include all forbidden variables.
